preconditions.description: The table dimensions n (rows) and m (columns) are within the bounds 1 to 100.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == m for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each of the n lines contains exactly m integers.

preconditions.expression: all(-100 <= int(num) <= 100 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] for num in line.split())
preconditions.description: Each cell value is an integer between -100 and 100 (inclusive).

postconditions.description: The output consists of two lines: the first line contains the count of row spells (a) followed by the distinct row indices (1-based) to apply the first spell; the second line contains the count of column spells (b) followed by the distinct column indices (1-based) to apply the second spell.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= sum(int(num) * (-1 if i+1 in rows else 1) * (-1 if j+1 in cols else 1) for j, num in enumerate(line.split())) for i, line in enumerate(stdin.splitlines()[1:]))
postconditions.description: After applying the row and column spells, the sum of each row is non-negative.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= sum(int(stdin.splitlines()[i+1][j].strip()) * (-1 if i+1 in rows else 1) * (-1 if j+1 in cols else 1) for i in range(n)) for j in range(m))
postconditions.description: After applying the row and column spells, the sum of each column is non-negative.
